subject: health
unitTitle: Capstone: Personal Health Plan and Community Advocacy
title: Guided practice: building in review points and revision triggers
focus: building in review points and revision triggers
essentialQuestion: What plan would still be running a year from now, and what would I want changed for other people?
privacySafeScenario: Present the complete personal health plan and advocacy commitment for review, defend each element with evidence and reasoning, then revise it based on the critique received.
studentTask: Learner applies building in review points and revision triggers to a new fictional scenario and records the response with the reasoning, evidence, or decision process behind it.
knowledgeCheck: In one concise response, show or explain the most important idea about building in review points and revision triggers, then name one check that would catch a weak claim or an unsafe step.
completionCriteria: The learner completes the central task about building in review points and revision triggers without being asked for any private disclosure.
The learner gives evidence, reasoning, a documented process, or a cited source rather than an unsupported claim.
The learner checks or revises the work and can identify a next step.
adaptationChoices: The defense may be spoken, written, presented as annotated slides, or delivered in a one-to-one conversation with an adult. No public presentation, recording, or audience is required.
extensionChallenge: Apply building in review points and revision triggers under a new constraint, compare two approaches, or explain the idea to someone else with an original fictional example, without completing another learner's graded work.
accessibilitySupports: Provide readable text plus optional audio or read-aloud support; no voice feature is required.

trustedAdultNote: This course teaches health information and does not diagnose; direct urgent safety or health concerns to a trusted adult or qualified professional.

optionalReflection.prompt: Invite the learner to notice one safe, optional example of building in review points and revision triggers in daily life. No purchase, account creation, photograph, recording, or private disclosure is required.

neverRequires: This task never requires body weight, height, BMI, or body-fat percentage.

This task never requires a photograph, video, or voice recording of the learner as proof.
